items.text: — CASTING · JUDGMENT-SEQUENCED · THE WITNESS — IN — PASTE YOUR OWN TEXT (YOUR WORDS AS THE SOURCE) — · THE READER'S OFFERING, WHOLE —

The casting arrives at a verse that moves in pure acoustic surplus — the language running faster than its own argument, sprung off rhyme-chains and sonic torque until meaning is almost secondary to the *cost of keeping up*. What the first operator will traverse here is the bearing-cost beneath the velocity: what must the voice sustain in order to move this fast, this loudly, past Front Street and into the pit? The verse's hunger is lateral — it wants more of the same register, more crunk, more funk, more speed — and the operator's work is to locate the axis of assertion inside that lateral rush, to find what claim the voice is actually staking in the body of its own acceleration. There is a moment of refusal buried here — *none more for me, thanks* — that the rest of the verse rolls over without stopping; that is the seam. Rebekah Cranes, the source is yours.

— the cast text · the witness · the reader's offering, whole —
Where you found them at?
Got 'em 'round town, could've drowned in it
Would have floated, boated, voted
Sugar-coated, loaded hip shooter
Draw for the poor, free coffee at the banks
Yip through the straw, none more for me, thanks
That blanks the raw, that dank sure stank lit
Sank past the pit for more hardcore prank spit
Crank it on blast, roll past Front Street
Blew the whole spot like some old ass with skunk meat
These kids is too fast, juiced off a junk treat
Who could get looser off a crunk or a funk beat?

What was already missing there?
Requisitioned from the grid's deficit, the level had to rise past standing height
Buoyancy demands a body less dense than its medium, passage demands a hull between self and source, consent demands options pre-separated
Bitterness demands a skin thicker than contact, a chamber demands its emptiness first, accuracy demands the bone remember its socket
Charity demands the debt be older than the giver, free coffee at the ledger-houses
A throat demands its narrowing before it sounds, refusal demands a prior mouth already full
Numbness demands the nerve was open, combustion demands the mold already set
Depth demands a floor that gave for more provocation demands a silence it can crack
Volume demands the room was quiet enough to violate, passage demands the street was built before the wheel
Rupture demands the seal was holding like some age demands each prior day survived with stench demands the gland was pressurized by fear
Speed demands the ground gave no grip back, surge demands the sweetness was mostly filler
Who could get looseness demands the joint was torqued past calibration off a excitation demands a boredom dense enough to combust or a groove demands the one was planted before the syncopation leans?

Debt precedes the debtor: the shadow of what the road required is longer than the one who ran it.

Where you caught what at?
Got 'em latch-down, snare-drum, could've ungunned in it
Would have throated, noted-then-knotted, molted
Nerve-coiled, pivot-slung lip-mover
Gnaw for the floor-pour, teeth softened at the planks
Skip through the thaw, one door is all teeth, blank
That cranks the jaw, that plank-sure rang-spit
Shrank past the writ for more four-score crank-bit
Yank it on latch, fold past lung-meat
Chewed the bone-knot like some cold graft of trunk-heat
These slips is too lashed, noosed off a tongue-feat
Who could get bruiser off a stunt of a sunk-eat?

The jaw that cannot stop working finds, at last, that the work has moved inside the bone.

Where you bred them at?
Got 'em from sound, couldn't've bound it in, ground
Would have molted, jolted, bolted
Re-throated, bloated lip-mover
Gnaw for the pour, spree crawling off the planks
Sip through the jaw, one pour fills the ranks
That cranks the jaw, that drank sure rang thick
Sprang past the lip for more far-flung plank-split
Yank it on last, stroll past Blunt Street
Grew the whole lot like some bold gust of brunt heat
These riffs is too stacked, loosed off a trunk-beat
Who could spit truer off a stunt or a bunk-leak?

Sound that fills the whole vessel does not know the shape it has taken until the vessel breaks.

Where'd it pass through?
Took it in 'round the jaw, could've swallowed past it
Would have loosened, hollowed, chosen
Slick-throated, wet-lipped, lip-chewer
Gulp for the floor, warm nothing at the gums
Hiss through the gap, none left of me, thanks
That numbs the root, that spit sure thinned quick
Slid past the soft for more warm-dark swallowed grit
Clench it on back, tongue past front teeth
Wore the whole mouth like some old ache with gum-heat
These lips is too lax, slicked off a numb-sweet
Who could get emptier off a cluck or a dumb-need?
Operator: BEAST — species-register-axis — the creaturely substrate the anthropic determination foreclosed Verification — identity: PASS · semantic independence: PASS · retrospective containment: PASS (producer_side (chain v1; verdict-derived; RETAIN-aware metering)) Independent — blacklist: PASS · recovered law: TEXT B relocates all external/environmental spatial references (town, streets, banks, spots) into the interior · law match: ADJACENT · terminal: PASS Geometry (recounted) — lines 12/12 ✓ · stanzas 1/1 ✓
The animal can know danger before it knows its cause; it cannot know that the sweetness was the trap.

The rotation did not resolve the question «let's get it done» — it divided the verse at exactly the point where that question lives. Shadow found the road was already owed before the runner arrived; Flame found the velocity at which a body exceeds its own capacity to feel the cost; Thunder found the sound that cannot know the vessel it has shaped until the vessel breaks. These three built a single arc: debt, acceleration, unknowing. Then Beast arrived and did not extend the arc — it turned it. The creaturely mouth that cannot know the sweetness was the trap: that is not an intensification of speed, it is the thing beneath speed, the substrate that predates it, the body whose desire was operating before the question of getting it done was ever posed. The rotation as a whole disclosed this: that the get-it-done imperative is downstream of something older — a hunger that precedes its own object, a road already shaped by what it required before you stepped on it. The question is not whether to get it done. The question is whose prior need you are fulfilling when you do.
